subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron classification use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or an extension of plugin scheduled-turn tags?
rationale: This is a durable cron API, storage, CLI, and UI contract, and the related opaque metadata PR was already closed pending owner-reviewed design.

options.title: Typed classification contract
options.body: Add a narrow first-party purpose/display/tags model that supports general filtering and reminder separation without relying on name parsing.

options.title: Freeform tags array
options.body: Implement the requested tags array directly and accept user-defined taxonomy as the primary cron organization model.

options.title: Plugin-only tags
options.body: Keep plugin scheduled-turn tags as cleanup metadata only and leave general user cron categorization out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Typed classification contract
recommendation.body: Add a narrow first-party purpose/display/tags model that supports general filtering and reminder separation without relying on name parsing.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest maintainer signal on the related cron metadata API/protocol direction and merged adjacent cron.list protocol work.
